source.title: Only 20% of Americans Hopeful About AI | Catholic Futurist

summary.title_hr: Samo 20 % Amerikanaca s nadom gleda na umjetnu inteligenciju | Catholic Futurist
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda podcasta Catholic Futurist snimljena je uživo na SENT Summitu. Voditelj Louis Kim s gostima Matthewom Harveyjem Sandersom, Taylorom Blackom i Vincentom Higginsom razgovara o usvajanju umjetne inteligencije iz katoličke perspektive. Teme su iznenađenja u brzini usvajanja AI-ja, promjene u zapošljavanju, otpuštanja u skladu s katoličkim socijalnim naukom, opasnost od centralizacije moći te suverena, lokalna umjetna inteligencija kao izraz načela supsidijarnosti. Razgovara se i o fizičkoj umjetnoj inteligenciji, humanoidnim robotima, privatnosti zdravstvenih podataka te o pitanju koja je posljednja ljudska uloga, osobito u hospicijskoj skrbi. Na kraju svaki sudionik u jednoj rečenici odgovara što je katolička umjetna inteligencija.
key_topics: fizička umjetna inteligencija i humanoidni roboti
zdravstvo, hospicij i posljednja ljudska uloga
key_points: Sanders ističe da je samo oko 20 % Amerikanaca optimistično glede smjera razvoja umjetne inteligencije. Smatra da je industrija loše objasnila koristi te tehnologije, a da bi odbijanje AI-ja na Zapadu, dok Kina nastavlja s usvajanjem, moglo postati egzistencijalni problem za Zapad.

Black navodi da je umjetnu inteligenciju teško dobro uklopiti u radne procese, osobito u malim i srednjim tvrtkama koje nemaju uređeno okruženje kakvo imaju velike tvrtke. Dodaje da AI otvara pitanje predodžbi o tome što znači biti čovjek.

Higgins objašnjava da je usvajanje u industrijskom radu na terenu sporije jer pogrešan odgovor AI-ja može imati teške posljedice. Ističe da AI neće zamijeniti radnika nego će poboljšati sigurnost, a da se pri zapošljavanju traže ljudi koji usklađuju rad AI agenata poput dirigenta, umjesto ljudi koji pišu kod.

Sanders opisuje dvojbu oko zapošljavanja ljudi za kontrolu kvalitete kad se modeli znatno poboljšavaju u nekoliko mjeseci. Upozorava da je zapošljavanje u uredskim zanimanjima zamrznuto i da bi se isto moglo dogoditi u fizičkim zanimanjima kad roboti postanu sposobniji, dok o tome gotovo nema rasprave među političarima.

Prema Sandersu, Papa je upozorio da centralizacija umjetne inteligencije vodi koncentraciji moći. Kao odgovor zagovara suverenu umjetnu inteligenciju na razini kućanstva, u skladu s načelom supsidijarnosti, jer mali modeli mogu obaviti 90 do 95 % zadataka. Predlaže da političari zatraže od Nvidije da 20 % računalnih kapaciteta prodaje potrošačima.

Black smatra da poslodavac pri otpuštanju mora brinuti da radnik zadrži tržišnu vrijednost, primjerice kroz prekvalifikaciju. Potiče tvrtke da AI koriste i za rješavanje novih problema te da preispitaju prirodu rada u katoličkom duhu, primjerice kroz bonus za vjenčanje ili slobodne zapovijedane blagdane.

Kim, koji je iz velike tehnološke tvrtke prešao u hospicijsku i palijativnu skrb, pita koja je posljednja ljudska uloga kad AI postane bolji u gotovo svemu u zdravstvu. Ljudsku pratnju ilustrira završnom scenom filma Heat, a Sanders primjerom iz filma Alien ističe da teške vijesti treba priopćiti čovjek, a ne ekran.
key_topics_en: nature of work and the Catholic company
physical artificial intelligence and humanoid robots
healthcare, hospice, and the last human role
key_points_en: Sanders points out that only about 20% of Americans are optimistic regarding the direction of the development of artificial intelligence. He believes that the industry has poorly explained the benefits of this technology, and that rejecting AI in the West, while China continues with adoption, could become an existential problem for the West.

Black states that it is difficult to integrate artificial intelligence well into workflows, especially in small and medium-sized enterprises that do not have an organized environment like large companies do. He adds that AI opens up the question of perceptions of what it means to be human.

Higgins explains that adoption in industrial field work is slower because an incorrect AI answer can have severe consequences. He emphasizes that AI will not replace the worker but will improve safety, and that in hiring, people are sought who harmonize the work of AI agents like a conductor, instead of people who write code.

Sanders describes the dilemma around hiring people for quality control when models improve significantly in a few months. He warns that hiring in office occupations is frozen and that the same could happen in physical occupations when robots become more capable, while there is almost no debate about this among politicians.

According to Sanders, the Pope warned that the centralization of artificial intelligence leads to a concentration of power. In response, he advocates for sovereign artificial intelligence at the household level, in accordance with the principle of subsidiarity, because small models can perform 90 to 95% of tasks. He proposes that politicians demand from Nvidia to sell 20% of computing capacity to consumers.

Black believes that an employer, when laying off, must take care that the worker maintains market value, for example through retraining. He encourages companies to also use AI to solve new problems and to reconsider the nature of work in a Catholic spirit, for example through a marriage bonus or holy days of obligation off.

Kim, who transitioned from a large tech company into hospice and palliative care, asks what the last human role is when AI becomes better at almost everything in healthcare. He illustrates human accompaniment with the final scene of the movie Heat, and Sanders, using an example from the movie Alien, emphasizes that difficult news should be delivered by a human, not a screen.
summary.title_en: Only 20% of Americans Look with Hope at Artificial Intelligence | Catholic Futurist
summary.abstract_en: The episode of the Catholic Futurist podcast was recorded live at the SENT Summit. Host Louis Kim speaks with guests Matthew Harvey Sanders, Taylor Black, and Vincent Higgins about the adoption of artificial intelligence from a Catholic perspective. Topics include surprises in the speed of AI adoption, changes in hiring, layoffs in accordance with Catholic social teaching, the danger of the centralization of power, and sovereign, local artificial intelligence as an expression of the principle of subsidiarity. Physical artificial intelligence, humanoid robots, the privacy of health data, and the question of what the last human role is, especially in hospice care, are also discussed. At the end, each participant answers in one sentence what Catholic artificial intelligence is.
